failed_or_abandoned: First analysis run crashed (ZeroDivisionError) on the empty Sun-frame inelastic delta = 340 keV spectrum at 400 GeV; guarded and reported as kinematically forbidden
Admixture scan initially started at rho = 1e-4, above the O1 limit (~1e-5); extended to 1e-6.5
Direct WimPyDD rho -> 0 check at rho = 0.01 is not a clean limit (O4 already contributes H = 0.21); the limit was taken from the analytic scan (N_lo -> 0.4298 vs pure O6 0.4286)
O4+O6 scan trimmed from eight to four rho values (both signs) to fit the foreground time budget; cross term is rho-independent to 1e-16

First compute run exceeded the 600 s foreground limit and was moved to the background by the harness (it completed); the script was then given a 530 s budget with per-spectrum caching and re-run in the foreground
